description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to process container management within the WPEFramework, including network interfaces, memory, CPU info, container iteration, and container administration.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating network interfaces, providing methods to get interface name, address count, and specific addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving memory usage statistics of a container.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving CPU usage statistics of a container.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over containers, providing access to container IDs.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container, providing methods to get container info, control its lifecycle, and access related resources.

classes.name: IContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton interface for managing container instances, including creation, retrieval, and logging configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID.
